svg.title: Database per Service
svg.desc: Database per Service. Each service owns its data; others go through its API or events, never its tables. Step 1, One shared database: One shared database: Payments renames a column and breaks Orders; a Customers report slows Orders. Step 2, Each service owns its data: Each store is private to its service: direct table access is cut, others go through its API. Step 3, Cross-service queries: No join across databases: call both APIs and join in code, or keep a local copy fed by events. Step 4, Cross-service transactions: No transaction spans the stores: each commits locally with its event; a failed step is compensated.

g.text: One shared database: Payments renames a column and breaks Orders; a Customers report slows Orders.
Each store is private to its service: direct table access is cut, others go through its API.
No join across databases: call both APIs and join in code, or keep a local copy fed by events.
No transaction spans the stores: each commits locally with its event; a failed step is compensated.
one shared database: every table, every service
